method: Source photograph recovered from its original Drive URL and verified against the SHA-256 already recorded in the atlas SVG. The crop retains the native photograph coordinates, perspective and any surface curvature. It is a specimen reference, not a rectified manufacturing master.
coordinateConvention: Native source pixels [x0,y0,x1,y1]; crop [65,125,604,732], 539 by 607 pixels, with no resampling.

patches.label: Junior Forest Warden / Canadian Forestry Ass’n.
findings: The Drive file is the same 720 by 960 photograph recorded by the existing reconstruction; its SHA-256 matches the atlas provenance.
The source shows tall, irregular embossed letter forms with larger initials in FOREST WARDEN, CANADIAN and FORESTRY ASSN.; the earlier drawing substitutes uniform font outlines.
The source maple leaf has serrated contours and branching veins that are simplified in the earlier drawing.
The catalogue identifies a metal badge with a worn copper finish. The photograph records its appearance. Physical dimensions, alloy, date and original die geometry are unverified.
candidateChanges: Updated the worn copper finish. The three fill colours and one stroke colour changed while the reviewed path coordinates and registration remained identical.
Manually traced shield outline and rim in the 539 by 607 source-crop coordinates.
Replaced uniform font outlines with individually constructed glyph paths, preserving the photographed changes in letter size, spacing and tilt.
Retained both dots flanking JUNIOR and the apostrophe and final period in the lower caption.
Refined the maple leaf against the photograph with a deeper left recess, distinct asymmetric basal lobes, irregular angular margins and tapered branching veins contained within the blade.
Retained the photograph’s perspective and visible curvature. The drawing does not claim a flattened die master; grain, reflected highlights and shadow contours are omitted.
patches.evidenceLimitations: The photograph supports a trace in its own coordinates. Lighting, embossing, perspective and surface curvature remain in the reference; it cannot establish a flat die master or calibrated material colours.

sources.medium: Metal badge with a worn copper finish.
sources.note: Lossless crop of the original JPG, without resizing, warping, colour alteration or generated detail. The source is preserved as photographed.
